semiconductor_relevance: High — Kohoku Kogyo specializes in advanced quartz components that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Kohoku Kogyo manufactures quartz components using their proprietary SSG method, which allows for high material efficiency and the production of complex shapes without cutting. Their products include lenses, rings, and nozzles that meet the stringent requirements of the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Manufacturing of quartz lenses and rings using SSG® method
Production of nozzles with high precision drilling capabilities
Creation of custom quartz shapes for various applications
Development of infrared heater lenses with broad transmission characteristics
